description: handlers.rs handle_query and handle_query_changes use args["filter"].take() and args["sort"].take() where args: Value (not validated as Object). serde_json::Value::index_or_insert for str keys panics on any non-Null non-Object value (e.g. Value::Bool, Value::Array, Value::Number). It silently promotes Value::Null to an empty Object. This means a request that passes a non-object args (e.g. a boolean) causes a panic — the tokio::task::spawn isolation in the dispatcher catches it, but the calling client gets a serverFail response with no diagnostic. The same pattern appears in Space/get, Message/get, Chat/get, Thread/get. The mailbox.rs handlers correctly use let Value::Object(mut args) = args else { return Err(...) } instead.
title: handle_query in handlers.rs uses args["filter"].take() which panics on non-object args
